sql_findings.name: histogram aggregation already seeks the list-order index
sql_findings.observed_plan: SEARCH request_events_v1 USING INDEX request_events_v1_list_order_idx (list_ts_ms>? AND list_ts_ms<?) + USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
sql_findings.note: SQL is bounded; the remaining API time is handler/bucket assembly and response size, not a missing index.

limits: SQLite fixture; production runs PostgreSQL, where the planner and index usage differ.
Seeded rows are synthetic and uniformly distributed.
Measured on an Apple M3 Pro workstation, not production hardware.
Server-side vs database split is inferred from comparing API latency with the same SQL executed directly, not from in-process spans.
